_note: USD per million tokens, used to estimate non-Claude costs (Claude's cost comes from the CLI itself). Gemini rates are the public Gemini API list prices as reported in Nov 2026 (mostly secondary sources; check ai.google.dev pricing). Flash is an introductory rate until 2026-12-31, then 1.50/7.50. Thinking tokens bill as output. 'unpriced' is a placeholder for any model not listed. 'weights' sets how much each provider's dollars count in weighted_usd: Claude quota is the scarce one, so it counts in full.
